messages:
Maria: Heads-up — Asia1 egress is seeing high 5xxs, slow responses for model endpoints. Noticed after the capacity shift at 03:12 UTC.
Sam: I'm seeing increased tail latency on gpool-asia1, but pods look healthy. Any DNS clues?
Lee: dig to api.redwood-inference.com -> resolves to egress-asia1: TTL 3600
Noah: confirmed. Looks like edge resolvers still honoring long TTLs from previous records. We pushed CNAME change at 03:14 with low TTL, but caches stuck.
Raj: oncall-bot, can we get a resolver cache flush list? /cc @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-194321 — Asia1 egress degraded. Run runbooks/egress-dns-failover.
Sam: paste dig output:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> api.redwood-inference.com @8.8.8.8
;; ANSWER SECTION:
api.redwood-inference.com. 3587 IN A 3.23.45.67
``` 
Sam: TTL is 3587, so most public resolvers won't pick up our 60s change.
Maria: That explains sticky traffic. Options: 1) BGP shift for region, 2) try targeted resolver cache purge with cloud providers, 3) issue change to authoritative NS with lower TTL but propagation slow.
Lee: Cloudflare supports 'purge by name' for us? We only control authoritative in our registrar DNS. Edge providers still caching.
Noah: Immediate mitigation: start traffic reweighting in traffic-steer at 40% -> us-west-2 for model-serving APIs. I'll open the route change.
Sam: Rolling reweight command:
```
redwoodctl traffic set api.redwood-inference.com --from asia1 --to us-west-2 --percent 40
```
Raj: Doing that now. Monitor pods and queue/drop metrics.
(oncall-bot): change applied. previous weight: asia1 100% -> asia1 60% us-west-2 40%
Maria: Also increase our KV cache tolerance on us-west nodes to avoid cold-start storm.
Lee: Meanwhile, ops: contact cloud DNS providers with request to clear resolver caches for our zone (ticket raised). List of providers and contact steps added to thread.
Sam: Note for post-incident: don't revert authoritative TTL so fast. Our earlier experiments set TTL 3600 and then tried to lower; need a pre-stage strategy.
Noah: Agreed. I'll start a short post-mortem doc in /docs/incidents/INC-194321 and include TTL-playbook suggestions.
Raj: Quick checklist we used:
- lower authoritative TTL to 60 (pre-step, at low traffic)
- coordinate with traffic-steer to shift weights before change
- notify major resolver providers + request purge
- use CNAME-based fallback IPs for faster rollouts
- monitor cache-hit ratio on edge resolvers
Maria: Thanks all. Keep thread live for 1 hour then move to postmortem.
Lee: metrics look stabilizing. 5xxs down 70% since reweight. closing in on recovery.
Noah: last check 03:29 UTC — traffic roughly 55% -> asia1, 45% us-west-2, latency back within SLO.
Maria: closing channel updates, will summarize in PM.
